name: Canvas Answers

pricing.summary: Paid pricing not stated on the site; homepage says 'Get Started - it's free'
pricing.freeTier: Homepage CTA says 'it's free'; limits not stated

featuresStated: Direct integration button on quiz pages
Multiple choice, true/false, matching, essay question types
notes: Site claims 98.97% accuracy and 100,000+ students (unverified). Download link redirects to a Chrome Web Store listing named 'SmartSolve - AI Homework Tutor' by NIKNEA, LLC (about 30K users, 147 ratings; the displayed rating value read '1.0' and should be checked by a human). The listing repeats the 98.97% claim. Site also links an App Store/iOS download. No pricing found in HTML; may be inside the app.

name: StudyFox

pricing.summary: Free Basic plan; paid plans from $2.99/week, $9.99/month, $29.99 per 4 months, $59.99/year, each with a 3-day free trial

plans.name: Basic (free)
plans.notes: 20 homework help, 3 notes, 3 flashcards, 3 quizzes, 3 mind maps per month

pricing.freeTier: StudyFox Basic: 20 homework help per month plus 3 each of notes, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps; up to 20 pages per document
pricing.trial: 3-day free trial on paid plans (via site plans API); 7-day money-back guarantee stated

featuresStated: Screenshot-and-solve Chrome extension with step-by-step answers
notes: Prices come from the site's own public plans API used by its pricing page (not shown in static HTML). Chrome Web Store listing: 199 users, 5.0 (9 ratings); its description says 'designed to be undetectable' and 'over 10,000 students', while the homepage says 1,000+ active students - conflicting, unverified. Extension is sold bundled with the study suite; the homepage markets mostly study tools, extension is one feature.

name: Apex Vision AI

plans.name: Mastermind
plans.notes: 2,000 requests/month; includes Apex AI Agents; no trial

pricing.freeTier: 30 free requests to start, plus a refill every 12 hours; no card required
pricing.trial: 1-day free trial on Knowledge Kickstart and Savvy Scholar

featuresStated: Highlight or screenshot questions for answers and explanations
Apex AI Agent that fills answer boxes on the open course page (Mastermind)

name: Screenshot AI

pricing.freeTier: 20 credits per month (1 credit per processed image)

featuresStated: Capture a screen region or paste an image
notes: Very small: Chrome Web Store listing shows 4 users and 4.0 (1 rating). Site states no specific LMS support and notes AI can make mistakes.

name: AskSia

pricing.summary: Free plan with no credit card; paid plan prices not found in static HTML
pricing.freeTier: Free plan, no credit card required; paid plans unlock unlimited uploads, full transcription, advanced note organisation

notes: Pricing page is client-rendered; plan prices not verified. Site states a one-time $79 for its SAT-prep app (Sia Agent) and mentions a Grade Confidence Guarantee on eligible A+ plans. Homepage text contains $9.99/$14.99/$15.99 in a competitor-comparison table but column attribution was unclear, so not recorded. Site claims 2M+ students at 2,000+ universities (unverified). Chrome Web Store: 6,000 users, 5.0 (28 ratings). Extension syncs LMS course content; main product is a study platform.
